channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Taming
item.description: Adds taming ability through PetAI to allow a bunch of the FOTSA animals to be tamed.

item.title: Tamables: Critters
item.description: Adds tamables for a few requested mods here and there

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Manidae
item.description: A collection of pangolins from the Holocene.

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Rhinocerotidae
item.description: A collection of rhinos from the Holocene.

item.title: The Sumpter (Class)
item.description: Adds a Sumpter class, focused on logistics. Comes with exclusive clothing, backpacks, and saddlebags

item.title: Prosequor - Skills, Levels, Trees and Stats
item.description: Adds a full-throated, first-class skill, levelling and attributes system to Vintage Story.

item.title: Feral Kinship: Companions
item.description: Turns tamed foxes into full companions with perks, moods, packs, expeditions, and more.

item.title: Simple water tweaks
item.description: This mod modifies the game's water by adding an alternative wave effect and a more vibrant color

item.title: TraderTweaks
item.description: Allow to manage traders

item.title: DarkGirlStuff
item.description: ADD some stuff, items, cloths for an server

item.title: TekTools
item.description: Adds a dedicated Tools tab to the Vintage Story character window, providing a clean home for TekTool

item.title: Ballista Patch
item.description: Reworked Ballistas with mountable logic

item.title: TurretLib
item.description: Library for mountable rotating turrets-like devices

item.title: Player Model NPCs
item.description: Placeable NPCs that can use any PlayerModelLib model, plus in-game activity and dialogue editor

item.title: Prosequor Plus
item.description: Adds compatibility between popular Vintage Story mods and Prosequor.

item.title: Barbershop Plus
item.description: Re-implements Barbershop as a full-fledged profession.

item.title: Block Overlay
item.description: The best x-ray mod so far 🎉

item.title: Transmittance
item.description: Sunlight passing through colored glass gets colored appropriately

item.title: Renewable Fallen Sticks
item.description: Regrows fallen sticks near mature trees over time, including trees grown from saplings.

item.title: Dragonia Translations
item.description: Переводы и отредактированные переводы под стиль сервера.

item.title: Lycan's Traits for My Race My Rules
item.description: Adds a bunch of new traits modifying different stats to be used for customizing classes & races.

item.title: Jaunt: Entity Movement System
item.description: Library providing an extended entity riding system with additional control patterns and stamina

item.title: Czech Patch - Čeština do módů
item.description: Mod, který přidá české překlady některých módů do hry. Adds Czech translations to some mods

item.title: Desk Picture Frame Plus
item.description: Adds Desk Picture Frames and Wall Frames - Can add your own images via the mod config folder

item.title: Metal Bowls Mod (for more bowls)
item.description: Adds metal bowls

item.title: GGBC's Repair
item.description: A very lightweight mod for balanced item repair. Compatible with ItemRarity, xSkills, and others

item.title: muppersrpg
item.description: rpg, rarity, stats and reskin for every weapon/tool/armor.

item.title: Spiro Loading Screen
item.description: Custom loading screen with server-side world preloading and chunk readiness checks.

item.title: Abilities
item.description: Gives everyone an ability to make everyone more unique.

item.title: Frontier Claims Map
item.description: Claim map and access controls for internal testing on a private server.
